description.p: Puplify records your microphone and the meeting's audio, transcribes both live and saves the full text transcript. No bot joins the call and nothing is summarised away.

ul.li: Transcribes on your computer with Whisper, or in the cloud with Deepgram
Tells you and the other participants apart by audio source
Sends finished transcripts to OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion, a folder or a webhook
Can start recording by itself when a meeting from your calendar begins

screenshot.caption: A transcript with the timeline of who spoke when

description.p: Records any call when another app takes the microphone, reads calendars from a private iCal link without signing in, and updates itself in one click.
Records meetings from your Google or Outlook calendar automatically, with Accounts and Calendar settings.
Ships with a multilingual Whisper model, so the first recording needs no download.
Windows support, a new interface and Google Drive, Dropbox and Notion destinations.
